title: Toddler with Stroller in Yard, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot taken in June 1956 featuring a happy toddler standing in a grassy yard beside a stroller or push toy in front of a house with clapboard siding. The margin carries the photofinisher date stamp 'JUN • 56'. It offers a classic slice of post-war suburban American family life and early childhood memories.
